name: teller
description: Read-only Teller integration for transaction and balance data via mTLS client certificates

docs.usage: Uses Teller Connect (CDN script) for the bank linking widget. API calls use mTLS with client certificates stored as base64 env vars.
docs.security: Access tokens are stored server-side only. The Teller API client uses mTLS — TELLER_CERT and TELLER_PRIVATE_KEY must be base64-encoded versions of your certificate.pem and private_key.pem from the Teller dashboard.
docs.flow: 1. Frontend loads Teller Connect script from CDN. 2. User connects bank. 3. POST /api/teller/enroll — saves access token. 4. POST /api/teller/sync — fetches all transactions and balances.
docs.env: NEXT_PUBLIC_TELLER_ENV should be 'sandbox' for development or 'development'/'production' for live data. Get certificates from Teller dashboard under API Keys.
